Mass 0.895 +/- 0.077 solar masses from Addison et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019PASP..131k5003A/abstract). entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,180 K and log g 4.51 (u1 0.606, u2 0.159): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
